idea.title: Caching was not the performance fix
idea.summary: While improving rental-page performance, caching initially looked useful, but measurement showed repeated payment aggregation work was the more relevant bottleneck.

context.situation: Financial information on the rental page was loading slowly.
context.problem: The request path was performing repeated aggregation work.
context.initial_thoughts: Caching was considered as a possible solution.
context.investigation: Measurement showed repeated database work was responsible for much of the delay.
context.decision: Optimize the existing query path before introducing caching.
context.result: The path improved without adding caching infrastructure.

learning_points: Measure the real bottleneck before adding caching.
Trace performance through the actual execution path.
More infrastructure is not automatically a better optimization.
story_points: Caching initially looked like the solution.
The final fix stayed inside the existing data path.
possible_angles: I nearly added caching to solve the wrong problem.
